abstract: Extragenital choriocarcinoma in the male is known to occur in retroperitoneum, mediastinum and pineal body in a high proportion, and there have been no certain reports of lung origin. We studied two cases of choriocarcinoma arising from the lung in the male by histological, electronmicroscopical, immunofluorescent, and immunoenzyme methods. Histologically, characteristic changes of choriocarcinoma, composed of irregular complex of cytotrophoblasts and syncytiotrophoblasts with massive necrosis and hemorrhage were demonstrated. These two cell patterns, characteristic of choriocarcinoma, were also demonstrated electronmicroscopically and differed from giant cell carcinoma of the lung. By immunofluorescent and immunoenzyme methods, anti-HCG reactive particles were seen in the cytoplasm mainly of syncytiotrophoblasts and proved HCG production function of the tumor.
abstract_ja: 男性の性腺外性絨毛癌は後腹膜、縦隔、松果体に高頻度に発生することが知られているが、肺由来の確実な報告はなかった。男性2例の肺原発絨毛癌を報告する。組織学的に、壊死と出血を伴う細胞栄養膜細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞の特徴的な配列を示した。電子顕微鏡でも同様の二つの細胞パターンが認められ、肺の巨細胞癌とは異なっていた。免疫蛍光法および免疫酵素法により、主として合胞体栄養膜細胞の細胞質内に抗hCG反応性粒子が認められ、腫瘍によるhCG産生機能が証明された。
